Bot buys ships at cycles 1, 6, 10 and builds only 3 lanes; sim buys the second ship at once and a fourth lane at 7. Replay of bot timing in the model: 8929 vs 8701 (the 228 difference is the stock buffer in the Buy order, about 400 per source).

Build limits: one ship per lane (T87 pending), only 4 profitable lanes in system 1 (marginal ships 1-4: 157, 157, 125, 125; ship 5+ near 0), no upgrades, no Hauler, no permits. Without them decent tops out near 8700-9000 in 30 cycles, with only a few cycles of margin.

rescue_spec_for_gameplay_programmer.new_rule: At end of cycle, if cash < fixed_cost() (route_engine.fixed_cost(), 115) AND no route is running (every route state is stalled or blocked, or there are no routes) AND stock cannot be sold for cash (no local Sell order has stock in storage, i.e. total sellable value = 0): pay rescue_stipend, show the existing notice. Keep the old zero-ships clause as an OR.
rescue_spec_for_gameplay_programmer.also: Mark run_stats rescue count as today. Not a loss, not a win. No new balance key. Fires at most once per cycle.
rescue_spec_for_gameplay_programmer.verify: QA bot always_expand inject run: cash 1 with 2 ships at cycle 4 must get 1000 at cycle 4 end and run again. Default decent run with 1600 start must never rescue.
rescue_spec_for_gameplay_programmer.note: Idle-by-closed-planet cases: blocked routes also count as not running, so an event that closes both planets can trigger a rescue; acceptable (setback only, still loses at cycle 30 if far from 9000).
